title: HTTP Access Log - Log Contract v1
description: Contract cho bronze layer: moi dong JSONL sinh ra boi traffic simulator (generator/) va duoc doc boi Spark ingest job phai tuan theo schema nay. article_id + cache_status gan truc tiep voi co che Cache-Aside (mon NoSQL).

ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC, do chinh xac milisecond. Vi du: 2026-01-15T10:23:45.123Z

trace_id.description: UUID4, duy nhat cho moi dong log - dung de dedup khi ingest.

session_id.description: UUID4 nhom cac request cung mot 'phien' (visitor session hoac attack burst).

user_id.description: Id nguoi dung da dang nhap. Null neu request la anonymous (chua dang nhap).

event_type.description: Phan loai nghiep vu cua request, doc lap voi viec request co bat thuong hay khong.

path.description: Duong dan request, bao gom ca query string neu co (vi du /search?q=laptop).

article_id.description: Id bai viet duoc truy cap (event_type == 'view_article'). Null neu request khong gan voi mot bai viet cu the, hoac id khong hop le (vi du payload SQLi).

cache_status.description: Ket qua tra cuu cache theo co che Cache-Aside: HIT = phuc vu tu cache, MISS = phai truy van nguon (va nap lai cache).

is_anomaly.description: Nhan ground-truth: true neu dong log thuoc mot chuoi hanh vi bat thuong.

anomaly_label.description: Loai bat thuong cu the. Bat buoc null khi is_anomaly == false, va bat buoc khac null (mot trong 4 gia tri) khi is_anomaly == true.
